admissions_overview.summary: In Zambia each university sets its own entry requirements by school and runs its own application process; there is no single national application service. The University of Zambia accepts applications online through its application portal or on paper forms, and its yearly admission advert lists minimum O-level credits (including English) that differ by school. It states that meeting the minimum does not guarantee admission.
admissions_overview.notes: Intake adverts, closing dates, programme lists and entry requirements change every year; check each university's current admission advert and portal. Programme lists here come from the universities' own programme pages or adverts and may lag behind new programmes.
